operator_contract.name: fmha_nvfp4_kv
operator_contract.entrypoint: Model.forward(self, query, kv_cache, workspace_buffer, block_tables, seq_lens, max_q_len, max_kv_len, bmm1_scale, bmm2_scale, batch_size, cum_seq_lens_q, cum_seq_lens_kv, window_left=-1, out=None, out_dtype=None, o_sf_scale=None, o_sf_vec_size=None, kv_layout='HND', enable_pdl=None, sinks=None, kv_cache_sf=None, skip_softmax_threshold_scale_factor=None, uses_shared_paged_kv_idx=True, causal=True, lse=None, return_lse=False, multi_ctas_kv_counter_buffer=None, use_fp16_softmax=None, uses_spcompress=None, backend='trtllm-gen')
operator_contract.semantics: Compute paged variable-length attention from the declared query representation and an NVFP4 KV cache, including scale decoding, causal or window masking, optional sink logits, BF16 output mutation and optional LSE output.
